records/skill:3:105/description.text: Elite Signet. For 5…17…20 seconds, all spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal 5…9…10 additional damage.

records/skill:3:109/description.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15…51…60 seconds, your attacks deal 5…29…35 more damage while under the effects of a weapon spell.

records/skill:3:125/description.text: Elite Signet. All party members lose all conditions. You are set on Fire for 1 second for each condition removed in this way.

records/skill:3:127/description.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack a foe with your scythe, you deal 10…22…25 slashing damage to all adjacent foes.

records/skill:4:336/description.text: Shout. Your next 5…8 attacks do an additional +14…20 damage.

records/skill:4:337/description.text: Shout. For 16…20 seconds, you have +24 armor and cannot be knocked down or Crippled.

Description: A Charr Bag is an equippable item that provides 10 additional inventory spaces. Because they already hold 10 items, they cannot be upgraded by using a Rune of Holding. A Superior Rune of Holding can be applied to it after leaving Pre-Searing and make it hold 15 items. A character may wear up to 2 bags at one time. Bags are not visible to other players.

Charr Bags are most commonly used by players in Pre-Searing who, without access to storage, have little inventory space.

Acquisition: * Ascalon (pre-Searing)
** The Northlands
***Warrior Scarl the Slicer
***Monk Blaze Bloodbane 
***Necromancer Red Eye the Unholy
***Mesmer Ghast Ashpyre
***Elementalist Jaw Smokeskin
* Depths of Tyria
** Forsaken Tunnels
***Warrior Charr Patrol Leader
***Warrior Wyle Brimscourge
***Elementalist Maz Scourgeheart
***Maz's Chest

Wiki notes: * Charr Bags use the same inventory icon as Jun's Art Supplies, Tasca's Pack, and Zehtuka's Pack.
* They appear to have the same model as the backpacks carried by some Merchants.
* This item cannot be dyed.
* Empty bags can be moved into other, equipped bags, or into your storage, but as with any other container, they cannot be unequipped until you remove all items.

records/green:1:8c5c9f712b06ef37/details.text: Description: A Charr Salvage Kit is a type of kit that provides the only method for pre-Searing characters to obtain upgrade components. They look and work the same as Expert Salvage Kits; however, they have only five uses and they can only be obtained as drops from one of the Charr bosses or Maz's Chest.

Acquisition: * Ascalon (pre-Searing)
** The Northlands
***Warrior Scarl the Slicer
***Monk Blaze Bloodbane 
***Necromancer Red Eye the Unholy
***Mesmer Ghast Ashpyre
***Elementalist Jaw Smokeskin
* Depths of Tyria
** Forsaken Tunnels
***Warrior Charr Patrol Leader
***Warrior Wyle Brimscourge
***Elementalist Maz Scourgeheart
***Maz's Chest

Wiki notes: * This kit used to be the only means of salvaging equipment modifiers while in pre-Searing Ascalon, including weapon upgrades, Runes, or Insignias. With the introduction of The Purveyor players are able to obtain the Infinite Superior Salvage Kit in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* As with any kit, its value will decrease proportionally as it is used.
* Although it is gold, identifying it will not contribute to the Wisdom title track (however it will increase the value of the kit if sold to a merchant).
* These kits can be used to salvage rare crafting materials, but there is no point in doing so: rare materials cannot be used in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* The base chance, before the Wisdom and Treasure Hunter bonuses, of breaking an item upon salvaging an upgrade is 50%.

- Having all four Monumental Tapestries added to his/her Hall of Monuments.

- Entering the area alone. No other players, no heroes, no henchmen.

records/skill:0:1/skill/description.text: Elite Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and hit 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.

records/skill:0:2/skill/description.text: Elite Hammer Attack. If Devastating Hammer hits, your target is knocked down and suffers from Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds.

records/skill:0:3/skill/description.text: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, you move 33% faster and gain double adrenaline from attacks. Battle Rage ends if you use any non-adrenal skills.

records/skill:0:4/skill/description.text: Elite Skill. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack with a sword, all adjacent foes take 10…30…35 slashing damage.

records/skill:0:5/skill/description.text: Elite Shout. Allies in earshot lose the Crippled condition. For 5…11…13 seconds, these allies move 33% faster.

records/skill:0:6/skill/description.text: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Ferocious Strike that deals +13…25…28 damage. If that attack hits, you gain adrenaline and 3…9…10 Energy.

records/skill:0:7/skill/description.text: Elite Stance. For 1…7…8 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks.

records/skill:0:8/skill/description.text: Elite Bow Attack. All your preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 5 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +5…17…20 damage if they hit.

records/skill:0:9/skill/description.text: Elite Trap. When Spike Trap is triggered, every second (for 2 seconds), all nearby foes are struck for 10…34…40 piercing damage, become Crippled for 3…21…25 seconds, and are knocked down. Spike Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

records/skill:0:10/skill/description.text: Elite Bow Attack. Shoot an arrow that moves twice as fast.

records/skill:0:11/skill/description.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…15…17 seconds, target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.

records/skill:0:12/skill/description.text: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 5…81…100 Health. Heal for an additional 30…98…115 Health if that ally is below 50% Health.

records/skill:0:13/skill/description.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…11…13 seconds, target ally gains +3…9…10 Health regeneration and 20…40…45 armor.

records/skill:0:14/skill/description.text: Elite Signet. Target foe is knocked down. That foe and all adjacent foes take 15…63…75 holy damage.

records/skill:0:15/skill/description.text: Elite Spell. Transfer all conditions and their remaining durations from your allies to you.

records/skill:0:16/skill/description.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target other ally gains +3…5…6 Energy regeneration.

records/skill:0:17/skill/description.text: Elite Hex Spell. For 6…25…30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -1…3…4 Health degeneration, and gain 25% less benefit from healing.

records/skill:0:18/skill/description.text: Elite Signet. Transfer all negative conditions with 100…180…200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. (50% failure chance with Curses 4 or less.)

records/skill:0:19/skill/description.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20…39…44 seconds, allies in the area are immune to disease, and anyone striking those allies in melee becomes Diseased for 3…13…15 seconds.

records/skill:0:20/skill/description.text: Elite Spell. If target foe has more Health than you, you gain half the difference (up to your maximum Health), and that foe loses an equal amount. If this foe has less Health than you, you lose half the difference, and that foe gains an equal amount.

records/skill:0:21/skill/description.text: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1…8…10 Energy. For each point of Energy lost, that foe takes 7 damage and all nearby foes take 75% of that damage.

records/skill:0:22/skill/description.text: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, spells you cast recharge 33% faster.

records/skill:0:23/skill/description.text: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target moves and attacks 50% slower and suffers -1…7…8 Health degeneration.

records/skill:0:24/skill/description.text: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 2…8…9 Energy. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.

records/skill:0:25/skill/description.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, Echo is replaced with the next skill you use. Echo acts as this skill for 30 seconds.

records/skill:0:26/skill/description.text: Elite Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe is knocked down and struck for 14…83…100 lightning damage, and has Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.

records/skill:1:164/skill/warnings/2/tex.text: If you are moving when it ends, the resurrected party member will be teleported to where you started running or where you last changed direction, not to your current position.

records/skill:2:282/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 Spirit (90 second lifespan). Every 4 seconds this spirit heals one non-spirit ally for 10…94…115.

records/skill:2:290/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Skill. (5…37…45 seconds.) Your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge 25…45…50% faster. Ends after 1…3…3 Binding Rituals.

records/skill:3:33/skill/pvp/conciseDesc.text: Elite Stance. (1…8…10 seconds.) You move 33% faster and deal +10…66…80 damage with your next melee hit. Ends when you hit or if you use a skill.

records/skill:3:38/skill/pvp/conciseDesc.text: Elite Stance. (4…9…10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.

records/skill:3:43/skill/pvp/conciseDesc.text: Elite Stance. (1…16…20 seconds.) You attack 15% faster and you gain +1 to your Marksmanship attribute.

records/skill:3:44/skill/pvp/conciseDesc.text: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…102…120 second lifespan). Adrenaline gain increases by 33…59…66% for creatures in range.

records/skill:3:55/skill/pvp/conciseDesc.text: Elite Spell. Heals entire party for 5…57…70. Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).

records/skill:3:71/skill/pvp/conciseDesc.text: Elite Hex Spell. Causes 100…180…200% slower enchantment casting (10 seconds). Initial effect: if target foe is not enchanted deals 10…82…100 damage to target and 75% of that damage to adjacent foes.

records/skill:3:75/skill/pvp/conciseDesc.text: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (10 seconds). These foes take 10…26…30 damage whenever they use a skill and 5…33…40 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.

records/skill:3:79/skill/pvp/conciseDesc.text: Elite Spell. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: also interrupts other foes in the area, and you steal 0…4…5 Energy from all foes in the area.

records/skill:3:88/skill/pvp/conciseDesc.text: Elite Spell. Deals 5…17…20 fire damage for each second since casting this spell (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location.

records/skill:3:102/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Item Spell. (30…54…60 seconds.) Your Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. Drop effect: deals 15…71…85 lightning damage to all foes in the area.

records/skill:3:105/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Signet. Target allied summoned creature deals +5…29…35 damage. That creature is destroyed after 10 seconds.

records/skill:3:111/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Shout. (4…9…10 seconds) Allies in earshot move 33% faster and gain 5…13…15 Health while moving.

records/skill:3:116/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Chant. (4…9…10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have 50% chance to block. Ends when hitting with an attack skill.

records/skill:3:122/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 45…97…110 Health with their next skill.

records/skill:3:130/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Form. (10…74…90 seconds.) Deal holy damage. You lose 1 hex whenever you use a Dervish attack skill. Heal yourself for 5…41…50 Health whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

records/skill:3:133/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Form. (10…74…90 seconds.) You have +100 maximum Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Cure 2 conditions from yourself whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

records/skill:3:137/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Scythe Attack. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5…17…20 seconds). Removes 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds).

records/skill:3:139/skill/pvp/conciseDes.text: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. (2…7…8 seconds.) You attack and gain adrenaline 25% faster.

records/skill:1:163/skill/pvp/warnings/0.text: Contrary to the description, Peace and Harmony doesn't cause conditions and hexes to expire 90% faster. Instead, all new conditions and hexes, applied during the enchantment, will have their duration reduced by 90%.

records/skill:1:195/skill/pvp/warnings/0.text: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.

records/skill:1:197/skill/pvp/warnings/0.text: This skill does not actually become disabled, as it can be instantly recharged by Glyph of Renewal, and the recharge reduced by Glyph of Swiftness.

records/boss:1:5a42971dd168bdf1/npc/note.text:
*Unlike other scarabs, she is a ranged attacker.
*Sometimes she is hidden at first and won't pop up until a party member approaches her spawn point. 
*She is surrounded by several Scarab Nest Builders who use lots of traps. Melee characters should be especially careful.
*The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range.
*Kepkhet can be pulled and won't return to the nest if at least one of the Scarab Nest Builders has been killed.
*If she casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity which will remove Mark of Protection.
*Aurek the Scarab Hunter in Augury Rock (outpost) tells you of her existence and that he has been hunting her.

He shares this spawning location with Clobberhusk, Poisonbough, and non-boss Pinesouls, so it may be necessary to zone a few times in order to find him. records/boss:1:2061471ed753ffa2/npc/note.text:
* Frostbite has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses.
* The easiest way to find him in Talus Chute is to repeatedly zone from Camp Rankor until he spawns at the closest location, which allows for finding him with minimal effort.
* He hardly ever spawns in the Ice Floe. On the other hand, be aware that he will only appear once you approach his location, which is near the tree in the center of the small area enclosed by a low wall right outside the gate of Thunderhead Keep. When Frostbite appears, 12 Azure Shadows will pop up from the ground and they can kill your whole party with a Signet of Judgment spike, so spread out.

records/boss:1:b01762a687f2bff9/npc/note.text:
* After Markis dies, two additional Jade Armors spawn, and the mission will not end until those are dead as well, giving players time to capture Barrage.
** Alternatively if the aim is to capture Barrage, a member of the party can use Heart of Shadow (or Viper's Defense) to shadow step from the first bridge onto the level below, and the team can then use additional shadow steps to get to that party member. Avoiding crossing the end of the first bridge means that Markis does not begin running towards the end of the mission, and so the groups up to him can then be cleared out at the team's leisure.
* There is a spelling error in his dialogue. He says "vengence" instead of "vengeance".

records/boss:1:fcb697c497783292/npc/note.text:
* This boss can appear in any of the four possible spawn locations, which he shares with Nayl Klaw Tuthan and Rwek Khawl Mawl.
* Does not always spawn, if he is not at the four locations above, rezone and try again.
* Immediately upon zoning into Perdition Rock, you can turn left and check one of his spawn locations without having to fight anything. You can keep rezoning until he does show up. 
* In hard mode, without some form of dedicated interrupt, this boss can be very difficult to defeat, especially with the Hydras that it is grouped with. A Wurm may also spawn in this area and make the battle even harder.
* This boss attacks with a hammer, even though its profession is Monk.

records/boss:1:9fbdad08885483b6/npc/note.text:
* Once a player gets in radar range of his location, Harn Coldstone will spawn and begin his patrol around the island. He moves through many enemy mobs, which can make catching up with him complicated; be careful to not aggro too many enemies accidentally. See Harn and Maxine Coldstone (Zaishen quest) for additional strategies.
* He shares his spawn point with Maxine Coldstone, so only one of them can be present at one time. If you see Maxine, then Harn won't be on the map, and vice-versa.
* Harn is less likely to spawn than Maxine.
* He is the only Enchanted boss without the word Custodian in his name, and who is not located in the Crystal Desert.
*Unlike other Elementalists, he attacks at melee range.
Unlike most Enchanted, this boss is considered fleshy.

records/boss:1:aa9313472b0ea40c/npc/note.text:
* Strategy: After killing the two Chaos Wurms, head to the left side and kill the popups (there is no need to go to the right side (unless farming for ecto)). From the left side stairway, target the nearest Terrorweb Dryder and pull with a bow. That will pull the Darknesses as well, but if you back up enough the Darknesses will return, and the Dryders will still follow you. Do not retreat too far or the Dryders will break aggro and return.
** This pull usually only works once, once the Dryders return they cannot be pulled away again. Kill the Dryders and then the Darknesses will be alone. This is a good strategy for players that solo farm the Tomb of the Primeval Kings.

records/boss:1:cc2fba562584396e/npc/note.text:
* Unlike other zombies, it does not take double damage from holy damage.
* Rotscale has 17700 health in Hard Mode. It's accompanied by two Damned Clerics, a Necrid Horseman, four Rotting Dragons, and three Skeleton Bowmasters.
* Five Smoke Phantoms popup at the bridge leading to Rotscale while fighting Rotscale and its group.
* Certain areas past the bridge around Rotscale periodically inflicts poison on party members and allies.
* You can pay for two buffs after summoning a Champion of Balthazar at the statue of Balthazar near the bridge to Rotscale:
** Morale Boost for {{cost|100}}: the usual +2% Morale Boost.
** Holy Blessing for {{cost|50}}: +25 maximum health and +3 health regeneration.
* While Rotscale can be killed during A Vengeance of Blades, doing so will not complete the related Zaishen Bounty.
* Rotscale is one of the few non-boss creatures that drops a unique weapon. Because it is not a boss, you cannot use a Signet of Capture on it.

** Even if you approach from the north, Orosen and his group runs to the Senji's Corner portal as soon as you enter compass range of their initial location. They start fighting the Canthan Guards around the portal when you get in compass range of their new location.

records/boss:2:7fb2bcf26fcdbf42/npc/note.text: * He can be pulled away from the group of Dredge he spawns in.

records/boss:2:9c1ab45a91ad1dc2/npc/note.text: * Falaharn Mistwarden uses the same skills.

records/boss:2:d7548dd45afa217f/npc/note.text:

* Although Wingstorm requires 9 Domination Magic, Bezzr does not use skills of that attribute. 
* Some players consider the 200 wanding damage done by this Mesmer boss in Hard mode to be abnormally strong.

records/boss:2:f446be3b28f8d771/npc/note.text: * He will be patrolling an area in a clockwise direction, accompanied by Nundak the Archer.

*Against an armor rating of 70 in Hard mode, Byzzr Wingmender can easily hit for 150 wand damage, so strong healing or damage reduction is recommended.

records/boss:2:6d675656d4fa7227/npc/note.text: * In close vicinity, Snapjaw Windshell can be found, the only boss with the elite skill Second Wind.

records/boss:2:bd2ebb93263fea0c/npc/note.text: * During Return of the Yeti, Arrahhsh Mountainclub also appears in Mount Qinkai. You cannot obtain the Golden Lantern from his usual spawn in Pongmei Valley. That quest item can only be found in his Mount Qinkai spawn.

records/boss:2:eaace92870185a32/npc/note.text: *Jacqui's group usually engages and kills Reefclaw Ragebound, another warrior boss. Occasionally Jacqui can get killed in these fights instead. If he survives Reefclaw, he might get in a fight with Whyk Steelshell's group, and get killed by them.

records/boss:2:52ac63470df65525/npc/note.text: * Whyk's group might get in a fight with Jacqui The Reaver's group if the latter survives his fight with Reefclaw Ragebound.

records/boss:2:634421c3a07ed891/npc/note.text: * When it spawns (which includes Rockhide and Saltspray Dragons), its group begins to move along the road from The Aurios Mines to Seafarer's Rest.

records/boss:2:607f9a4c78ddcdce/npc/note.text: *This boss is sometimes ganked by mobs and will be killed. A free morale boost can be obtained this way just by watching the show near the area.

* He will engage the local wildlife with his mob of outcasts, and he can lose these fights if he lures too many mobs, especially if one of them contains another boss. Although he will not drop loot if he is killed by the wildlife, his elite skill can still be captured.

records/boss:2:358845c62a3a6754/npc/note.text: *After completion of Winds of Change, this boss appears alone in the Silent Surf.

records/boss:2:e2a85e5d3611fa5c/npc/note.text:
* The Whispering Ritual Lord does not spawn if The Dragon Hunter is active. This is evident by the presence of Turimachus directly outside the portal to Leviathan Pits, or the presence of Saltspray Dragon Eggs in the vicinity of where Whispering Ritual Lord should be.
* Whispering Ritual Lord patrols in a large area without a mob. However, due to the number of mobs in that area, it is advisable to clear some before engaging him, as it would be easy to accidentally aggro more than one mob when fighting.
* In hard mode, Ritual Lord does not increase its Communing rank, since attributes are capped at rank 20.

records/boss:2:b47c7cd7956138ad/npc/note.text: * Unlike most non-afflicted Factions bosses, Chazek does not drop a unique item.

records/boss:2:72fcfd07a4d1b45a/npc/note.text:

* Keep in mind that due to the map that this boss is on, if you do not pass a Resurrection Shrine or have access to a resurrection shrine (i.e. if the area is owned by the faction you have less unspent faction of) while attempting to kill this boss, and you die, you will have to restart the map completely.
* If not engaged in melee, it is possible to lure Kunvie and their group to an extent where the boss and the rest only use attacks and do not use spells.

*There is a rare miniature version of these creatures.
*In addition to the Oni weapons listed above, Oni in Echovald Forest and The Jade Sea can drop weapons that only Echovald Forest wildlife and The Jade Sea wildlife can drop (e.g. Amber weapons and Jade weapons), respectively.

*Defeating Urgoz for the first time increases your Kurzick faction cap by 10,000.

records/boss:2:54024e872e6f1204/npc/note.text:
* It is located in the area where there are two Mantid Hatchlings, but does not always spawn. Killing the two Mantid Hatchlings will cause two Mantid Drones to popup and attack. Killing both the Mantid Drones will cause another three mantids to popup - a Mantid Monitor, a Mantid Drone, and either Yunlai Deathkeeper or a Mantid Darkwing.
* As noted above, this boss may or may not spawn. If it does not spawn, a level 6 Mantid Darkwing will spawn instead, so just map travel back to the Minister Cho's Estate oupost and make the journey again until Yunlai spawns.
* Yunlai will always spawn if you adhere strictly to the following approach. When entering the temple and before killing any mantids, go immediately to the left chamber. There you will find a Mantid Monitor: kill it. Next, kill the two Mantid Drone Hatchlings. Two Mantid Drones will popup: kill them, and two Mantid Drones and Yunlai will popup. Killing any other mantid other than the ones mentioned, may prevent Yunlai from appearing.

records/boss:3:6b059dfeb5767dd1/npc/note.text:
* He will not appear in Arkjok Ward if the quest The Great Escape is active; Commander Kubeh (a ranger boss, with Barrage as his elite skill) will appear at his location instead.
* He and his group will start patrolling as you near his position.

records/boss:3:3314123b5b00d9bc/npc/note.text:
* If you can, prevent the acolyte from invoking the form, e.g. by interrupting.
* In hard mode, applying Daze and Weakness will make things much easier.
* Kill the guards and healers before attempting to take on the boss.

records/boss:3:f398220937bab4cf/npc/note.text: * Be extremely careful of this boss' Spirit Rift. In Normal Mode, the amount of damage this skill can do is already high, but in Hard mode, it is capable of dealing 500+ damage to each character, easily killing all of a clumped group. When he uses Spirit Rift you have 3 seconds to flag your heroes away.

records/boss:3:475b147b2e12af66/npc/note.text:
* He does not have an item spell to benefit from Renewing Memories. 
* He is located right next to two other groups containing bosses, use caution when approaching him.

records/boss:3:497591e09e3fe109/npc/note.text: * Be careful not to over-aggro; the area he's in is swarmed with many different types of creatures, including two other groups with bosses. The group Mhedi travels with is also rather large, which makes it a challenge to get the skill capture.

records/boss:3:11eefba06f8b9f53/npc/note.text: * Regardless of whether or not he is killed during the mission, he will appear later in Vabbi as Lieutenant Vanahk with the same appearance and skills.

records/boss:3:642c1c1b4a559143/npc/note.text: *Regardless of whether or not she is killed during the mission, she will appear later in Vabbi as Commander Sadi-Belai with the same appearance and skills.

records/boss:3:a27a4791b6f735d7/npc/note.text: * Regardless of whether or not she is killed during the mission, she will appear later in Vabbi as Corporal Suli with the same appearance and skills.

records/boss:3:4156a51f89ab6317/npc/note.text: * Some Ibogas patrol through Lunto and his group's path.

records/boss:3:9c5cfd7a5de2531f/npc/note.text: * Consider bringing two Signets of Capture when capturing Grenth's Grasp since Acolyte of Melandru is just north of this boss.

records/boss:3:264aa9468204bb5b/npc/note.text:
* Conditions and elemental damage are ineffective against this boss when it uses Avatar of Melandru. 
** Keep her interrupted - she is much easier to kill if her form is not active.
** Kill the guards and healers before attempting to take on the boss.
** In hard mode, applying Hexes will make things much easier.
* Party wide protection skills like Aegis work well.
* Consider bringing two Signets of Capture since Bubahl Icehands is just south of this boss.

records/boss:3:445189b4f5b6bb90/npc/note.text: * It is accompanied by several Blood Cowl Hekets.

records/boss:3:886d79985a78eeff/npc/note.text:
* It is easier to reach this boss travelling south from Venta Cemetery. Travelling north from the Command Post you will come across Mandragor spawns.
* This boss may not spawn while you have Building the Base: Prisoners of War active.
* Consider bringing another Signet of Capture to get Avatar of Lyssa from the nearby boss.

records/boss:3:30f1c65d09f26945/npc/note.text:
*Protective Spirit and similar enchantments can help with the damage reduction.
*Enchantment removal will counter Twin Moon Sweep.
*Consider bringing another Signet of Capture to get Reaper's Sweep from Dabineh Deathbringer.

records/boss:3:367edea3cbb2538a/npc/note.text:
* Sergeant Behnwa has an Elder Hyena for an animal companion. It cannot be charmed.
* The fastest way to reach him is from Sunspear Sanctuary (as part of a GoD run). Second from Venta Cemetery (storyline) and third from Gate of Desolation. His Kournan group stands near a bridge often used to cross the explorable area.

records/boss:3:fbc8b2772be606df/npc/note.text:
* In Hard mode, Korr can easily wipe an entire party due to fire damage as high as 400 from Searing Flames. Consider using an interrupt such as Signet of Humility, Power Block, or Complicate to disable Searing Flames. 
* Alternately, you can reduce damage with Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm and use Pain Inverter to quickly dispatch the boss. This method is particularly useful when the party has a minion master or spirit spammer.

records/boss:3:d17e801dc65669fb/npc/note.text: * This boss may not spawn when the quest Weird Waters is active. However, if he does spawn, his group will attack the heket groups that are related to the aforementioned quest.

records/boss:3:a8403b49fb81e2c1/npc/note.text: * Commander Noss is inaccessible during the quest To Kill a Demon

records/boss:3:6706af0dcd91d1f8/npc/note.text:
*If you have not completed the quest Drakes on the Plain yet, make sure you don't include Koss in your party, otherwise Zelnehlun Fastfoot will not spawn.
*To trigger Zelnehlun Fastfoot and his mob, walk towards the resurrection shrine near the fortress.

records/boss:3:da0eb89bc95cfd79/npc/note.text:
* Jerneh Nightbringer, together with a large mob, will only appear once the players have approached his location.
* Curiously, Jerneh's ambush consists of both skale and heket.

records/boss:3:8601b81f75298d21/npc/note.text:
* The Drought is a non-demonic servant of Abaddon; Lightbringer's Gaze is useless against it.
* The following tactics are effective in dealing with the Drought:
** Winter will negate the bonuses from earth damage.
** The Drought can be shutdown by daze, Power Block or knock downs. 
** Pain Inverter is even more effective using a minion master to exploit Sandstorm's area of effect damage — the more minions that get hit, the more damage there is to invert.
** Protective Spirit is effective, since the Drought almost always hits for over 200 damage.
** Shelter provides enough party-wide protection to kill the Drought using the Pain Inverter strategy (it generally will not survive more than one Sandstorm).

records/boss:3:df06c41da5fe9cb2/npc/note.text:
* This boss can hit for large amounts of damage. It is recommended to spread your team to avoid its area of effect attacks.
* This boss relies almost entirely on physical damage, so blocking and causing its attacks to miss are effective ways to prevent damage.

records/boss:3:bada5a660e3a6236/npc/note.text: *When it is aggroed, Mandragor Imps will popup.

records/boss:3:135116e4c695cc71/npc/note.text:
* He will charm a nearby level 15 Elder Crocodile.
* Even though he uses a monster skill form of Charm Animal, you can only capture the regular version from him.

records/boss:3:3f767e403bc41f57/npc/note.text: * Churrta the Rock will not spawn if the quest Eavesdropping is active.

records/boss:3:15cc22e850e04a74/npc/note.text: *He spawns very close to several other bosses. Players working on their Skill Hunter title may wish to bring several Signets of Capture with them.

records/boss:3:12d87afa54e2f63c/npc/note.text: *He spawns very close to Riseh the Harmless and Wandalz the Angry. Monk and Paragon secondaries (or any combination) may wish to bring 2 Signets of Capture.

records/boss:3:75f946f31bb66ed1/npc/note.text: * This boss is hidden and only appears once you're close to him.

records/boss:3:affb272b947cc0cf/npc/note.text: * Killing this boss will cause you to fail Masters for the mission, so you may want to go back and capture the elite skill after completing the mission or you can capture it from Chidehkir, Light of the Blind in Marga Coast.

records/boss:3:55959f0f94fafc4f/npc/note.text: Though Lumanda has a feminine appearance, he is referred to with male pronouns in the mission dialogue.

records/boss:3:5bc996f7ffeac3b6/npc/note.text: This boss does not spawn. The solution to this bug [{{fullurl:Feedback_talk:Emily_Diehl|diff=1967523}} was known by ArenaNet], but was never implemented.

records/boss:3:bb486cee56080160/npc/note.text:
* Elementalists capping the skill may wish to bring a second Signet of Capture, as an Elementalist boss with Master of Magic is along the way.
* This boss deals heavy damage in Hard mode. Consider bringing damage reduction skills such as Protective Spirit or "Save Yourselves!", or caster shutdown methods in form of interrupts or dazed. Spreading out before engaging Lushivahr will also prevent Invoke Lightning from hitting multiple party members.

records/boss:3:b93b97420601b816/npc/note.text:
* In hard mode, Master of Magic does not increase nor decrease its rank 16 Earth Magic, since rank 20 Energy Storage causes Master of Magic to set elemental attribute ranks to 16.
* Elementalists capping Master of Magic may wish to bring a second Signet of Capture, as an Elementalist boss with Invoke Lightning is in the area.

records/boss:3:d7097b282f55612e/npc/note.text:

In Normal Mode, the amount of damage this skill can do is already high, but in Hard mode, it is capable of dealing 500+ damage to each character, easily killing all of a clumped group. When he uses Spirit Rift you have 3 seconds to flag your heroes away.
* Bohdalz the Furious spawns near Jarimiya the Unmerciful. If seeking the least amount of foes possible, see the path on Jarimiya the Unmerciful's page.

records/boss:3:b929f0d6a5fe17d7/npc/note.text:
* This boss always drops one Bottle of Vabbian Wine when it dies, although it can be assigned to NPCs, such as henchmen, heroes or Vabbian Guards (in which case you will not see the drop).
** All enemy groups between the portal to Forum Highlands and Jarimiya can be pulled towards the nearby groups of Vabbian Guards for extra help when solo farming; this includes the group of Bohdalz the Furious.

records/boss:3:ef5bd75d237b1c21/npc/note.text: * The boss is located near a "Do Not Touch" treasure. Be sure to kill off her group before going for that treasure.

records/boss:3:341d9b0d5f622963/npc/note.text:
* He will charm a nearby level 15 Elder Crocodile.
* Even though he uses a monster skill form of Charm Animal, you can only capture the regular version from him.

records/boss:3:f14b46df443353d6/npc/note.text: *Tenezel the Quick does not appear when the quest The Search for Enlightenment is active

records/boss:3:3f30c99f5f843eaa/npc/note.text:
* Yammiron, Ether Lord will not appear in the Mirror of Lyss if The Search for Survivors is active.
* The Roaring Ethers can resurrect him; consider taking them out first.
* In Hard mode, Yammiron and his group can wipe a party with Energy Surge spikes. Keep spread out and try to prevent them from launching coordinated attacks. It helps to bring AoE skills such as interrupts (e.g. Panic or Psychic Instability), knock downs (e.g. Meteor), or daze (e.g. Broad Head Arrow).

* Shezel will not spawn if the Search for Survivors is active.
* There is Buried Treasure on the island where Shezel is located.

records/boss:3:b9f3604a5a087be5/npc/note.text: *If Briahn is accompanied by a Kournan Bowman, his group will trail Spirits of Infuriating Heat behind. Attacking one will cause the entire group to rush back toward you until the spirit dies.

records/boss:3:a1509c983e308dcd/npc/note.text:
* This boss will not appear in Resplendent Makuun during the quest The Search for Survivors.
* Even though he is a Paragon, he attacks in melee.

records/boss:3:02887aa2ee700e7b/npc/note.text: *In Dasha Vestibule, Kormab deals a large amount of damage when Searing Flames hits. Mass condition removal such as Cautery Signet, Martyr or Extinguish may be useful.

records/boss:3:3836e0f5079ee740/npc/note.text:
* He can spawn in a team with 1-2 Skree Griffins.
* Healer's Boon makes this a hard boss to defeat, though standard caster counters work wonders on him (daze, knockdowns, enchantment removal, interrupts, etc).
* If a Skree Singer spawns in the group they can resurrect Josinq the Whisperer using "We Shall Return!". This can make killing him difficult as he will use his Renew Life to resurrect the Singer if it is killed nearby. Consider Frozen Soil.
* Any nearby monster spawns should be wiped to prevent fighting two groups at the same time (the monsters spawning with Josinq, as well as heroes and henchmen, are likely to run into aggro range of nearby groups).
* He does not spawn with quest "Til Death Do Us Part..." active.

records/boss:3:03a2d2f3fc4e61f6/npc/note.text:
* Will not spawn until the quest Brains or Brawn is completed
* Bansheh, Gatherer of Branches may not spawn if the quests Worst. Performance. Ever., or Deactivating N.O.X. are active.
* In hard mode, Expert's Dexterity does not increase its Marksmanship rank by two (i.e. 20 to 22), since attributes are capped at rank 20.
Sometimes Bansheh, Gatherer of Branches will not spawn even if the above quests are not active.

records/boss:3:63a3c26bd5f00811/npc/note.text:
* This boss does not spawn until after completion of the quest Extinction.
* The group this boss is tied to is particularly dangerous due to the high number of resurrection skills they carry, including the boss and at least one Skree Singer with "We Shall Return!".
This boss has been observed to throw shields.

records/boss:3:198d0ded4834b2e5/npc/note.text:

* If Scratcher is still alive, the harpies near her will remain until she also is defeated.

records/boss:3:02c8105da0e372d0/npc/note.text: *When Scratcher and her group are killed, another group of elite skree will spawn and begin to attack you. However, after just one of these skree is killed, the rest will flee to the Resplendent Makuun portal and disappear.

records/boss:3:8719ae2bb53df419/npc/note.text: * Frozen Soil is particularly useful against this boss as members of his group carry multiple hard res skills including Renew Life and "We Shall Return!".

records/boss:3:d1ec28e8bc19e269/npc/note.text: "Heardheart" may be an unintentional typo of "Hardheart" which would make more sense for this necromancer boss.

records/boss:3:4609aa6149ad97dc/npc/note.text: * The djinn does not actually drop an essence that needs to be picked up. Killing it will immediately update the quest.

records/boss:3:84e3bab64bc2c499/npc/note.text: * If you intend to capture a skill from Shakor Firespear during the Dasha Vestibule mission, make sure to not kill him last as doing so will cause the mission to end.

records/boss:3:332d0f1d8cfb7823/npc/note.text: A necromancer boss named Eshekibeh Longneck strangely drops Marobeh's Chill. The names are likely unintentionally swapped.

records/boss:3:0ca3db40f9ce99e8/npc/note.text: *This boss may not spawn if the quest Coffer of Joko has not been completed, and Master of Whispers is in your party. See the talk page for more information.

records/boss:3:d54977e994778b92/npc/note.text: * Avah the Crafty is the second boss to appear while battling the waves of undead during the Gate of Desolation mission.

records/boss:3:8f79dde74ada7e77/npc/note.text: * Chakeh the Lonely is the first boss to appear while defeating the undead in the Gate of Desolation mission.

records/boss:3:75c250ff88be8b4f/npc/note.text: *Chundu the Meek is the third boss to appear while defeating the undead in the Gate of Desolation mission.

records/boss:3:c9b9dccf65ed54b1/npc/note.text: * Nehmak the Unpleasant is the fourth boss to appear while defeating the Undead in the Gate of Desolation mission.

records/boss:3:0367345cd4464927/npc/note.text: * He wields a Crenellated Scythe, but his weapon drop is a Bronze Scythe.

records/boss:3:cfacd9f0b2c3f1fd/npc/note.text: * It is possible to kill this boss to capture its elite without completing the Gate of Desolation mission. Joko's Domain is accessible via Basalt Grotto and the path to this boss does not go through any sulfurous sand.

records/boss:3:9ca23fa7d2bb379c/npc/note.text:
*It is possible to kill this boss to capture its elite without completing the Gate of Desolation mission. Joko's Domain is accessible via Basalt Grotto and the path to this boss does not need to go through sulfurous sand if the player heads south to the resurrection shrine with a Mandragor Hunt bounty and then heads northwest to come up south of the boss. 
*Uses a staff until an enemy is within approximately half of the aggro bubble of her.

records/boss:3:2cba94ddf479ed50/npc/note.text: * This boss is very close to the entrance to the Lair of the Forgotten. A Wurm Spoor is nearby, making it very easy to farm Dunshek and his entire group in Junundu form.

records/boss:3:d984d9981589d63f/npc/note.text: * If traveling to Saushali to capture Magebane Shot, one might consider taking another signet of capture as Uhiwi the Smoky with Smoke Trap is along the route.

records/boss:3:bdebb401230f3fd7/npc/note.text:
*Easily farmed while in Junundu form. Starting from the Lair of the Forgotten, it takes about 4 minutes to reach and kill him. 
*Saushali the Frustrating with Magebane Shot and Koahm the Weary with Quicksand are also in the area (unless Horde of Darkness is active).

records/boss:3:a39f361ce38bc791/npc/note.text: * Uhiwi the Smoky with Smoke Trap is also in the area.

records/boss:3:6e75211c9e79efb5/npc/note.text: * Sometimes this boss might not spawn if the quests Under New Management or The Scourge of Vabbi are active.

records/boss:3:37ce2033e35dd026/npc/note.text: *Occasionally two Desert Wurms will spawn in the group surrounding this boss. If this occurs, taking out the Desert Wurms first will make killing the rest of the group easier.

records/boss:3:23c6b7775baa1959/npc/note.text: * If you run a spirits build you may consider Vanquishing this zone when capping the skill as it works extremely well with Signet of Spirits.

records/boss:3:66d7574b1fb5b964/npc/note.text: * Droajam, Mage of the Sands is also present in the explorable and though it's a fair trek it may be useful to take two Signets of Capture for the other Elementalist elite (Sandstorm).

records/boss:3:491efbd53d6bb93b/npc/note.text:
*Consider bringing two Signets of Capture, as Mekir the Prismatic, the boss carrying Ether Prism, is in this area.
*You may wish to start from The Mouth of Torment, as it's a shorter walk.

records/boss:3:cda490e7575a47b7/npc/note.text:
* It is possible to kill this boss to capture its elite without completing the Gate of Desolation mission. Joko's Domain is accessible via Basalt Grotto and the path to this boss does not go through any Sulfurous Haze sand.
* There are many creatures surrounding Shekoss the Stony, so pulling is essential if you want to kill him.

records/boss:3:7b60317105770f62/npc/note.text:
Hassin and the group of insects around him don't try to attack you or come towards you if you attack them with a ranged weapon. They will also not attack your pet either if your pet goes and attacks them while you are attacking them with the ranged weapon.

Hassin and the group will not scatter when you use AoE skills, for example Fire Storm, if you are right on the edge of your range and don't attack them with your weapon.

records/boss:3:cdffcd6e11938b65/npc/note.text: * Several Istani Cultists can be found around it. They will attack if you approach.

records/boss:3:26daeeb020bbb329/npc/note.text: *If seeking to capture this boss' elite skill, consider bringing along an extra Signet of Capture, as Faveo Aggredior is nearby and is the only boss who carries Assault Enchantments.

records/boss:3:698e34cef6796129/npc/note.text: * He is initially friendly and turns hostile a few seconds after finishing his dialogue.

records/boss:3:0257d448b82eaa93/npc/note.text:
* When this boss's group is killed, an additional smaller group comes forward.
* Directly behind this bosses' spawn location is a treasure chest.

records/boss:3:e0791912ad3a2d98/npc/note.text: *If seeking to capture this boss' elite skill, consider bringing along an extra Signet of Capture, as Chimor the Lightblooded is nearby and is the only boss who carries Mark of Insecurity.

records/boss:3:807391e55d9a0f57/npc/note.text:
* Saevio Proelium is mentioned in the quests A Brief Introduction and Between a Rock...
* He usually spawns with 3-5 Pain Titans.

records/boss:3:43a11d4b3c882e35/npc/note.text: * The Margonites that are grouped with this boss are flanked by two groups of Torment creatures. Careful separation of the mobs is recommended.

records/boss:3:e97a600c0b4a69a2/npc/note.text:
* The path shown on the map can be quite difficult due to the 3 closely gathered groups of Margonites and Torment creatures on the other side. Still, it is possible to lure one group away from the others. An alternative would be to take a right turn in front of the bridge and follow the path from there on (staying near the west edge of the path) until one goes around to cross a black bridge that leads directly to the boss. There are small mobs along the way, but this should be remedied with a decent party. This is a longer, but safer way to approach the boss without having to suffer any sort of death penalty.

* This boss does not spawn in the mission. You must enter the zone from the Gate of Fear and then exit to Domain of Pain to reach the boss.

records/boss:3:7270e6f4725a5b3f/npc/note.text:
* Because Soul Torture has a very long activation time without technically doing anything, consider waiting until the Tortureweb Dryder begins activating it before entering its aggro and engaging it. Avoid using interrupt skills or attacking it with weapons (because Soul Torture is easily interruptible) during this time.
* Make sure to spread out to prevent heavy area of effect damage from Liquid Flame and Fireball, which could overwhelm healers if not careful.

records/boss:3:d5619951d86d37ba/npc/note.text: *This boss uses ranged attacks instead of its dagger attack skills.

records/boss:3:76775760b62dae83/npc/note.text: * Master of Misery's group moves in a patrol path from the initial location indicated on the map to near the entrance of the temple, and then back again.

records/boss:3:2ee2d3ff6a735533/npc/note.text: *Caution while engaging this foe is advised, as fighting will most likely take place on said bridge, leaving less space to maneuver but exalting the tactical value of a Ranger's traps at the same time.

records/boss:3:9a68a031bbaada98/npc/note.text:
*Sometimes Exuro Flatus will become passive (stop attacking or casting offensive spells) for short periods of time.
*Exuro Flatus cannot attack.

*If leaving from the Gate of Madness, beware as you can immediately aggro a group of Shadow Army foes.
*A group of Shadow Army foes can walk within Exuro's area, making farming difficult.

records/boss:3:9067f3b511ed6255/npc/note.text:
* You may find it quicker and easier to enter from the Gate of Madness - it is possible to avoid all the titans on your way to this boss.
* Be cautious when bringing any highly damaging elite skill as the boss will copy it and wipe your party if given the chance.

records/boss:3:c5d09ed34d5d1100/npc/note.text:
* Razakel was one of the demons that helped Abaddon cause the Cataclysm.
* Razakel is also a common name used for a demon in many games and stories.

records/boss:3:6bc21d1fc03f6a74/npc/note.text:
*When slain, the enemies that spawn after it may not necessarily appear immediately. If they do not, move closer to where the Greater Darkness was defeated.
*A Spirit of Truth will spawn near the reward chest after the death of the Greater Darkness, all his spawned and accompanying Darknesses, as well as the Earth Tormentors they spawn.

records/boss:3:4b4c68ddc691cbd5/npc/note.text: *This Monster looks like a Flesh Golem created by the Necromancer skill Animate Flesh Golem.

records/boss:3:06f6ae5c11a412ec/npc/note.text:
* To make the fight easier draw him away from his spawn point towards the City of Torc'qua. Putting your casters behind the fortress wall will allow them to cast spells in relative safety (Jadoth and his ranged allies will be unable to hit them).
** Alternatively there is a cliff on the other side of the fortress. Hiding your casters beneath that cliff will yield similar results.
* Jadoth's group has two monks, make sure to take enough anti-healing skills.
* He is very powerful and will make short work of parties approaching him when allowing him to cast his Storm of Judgment too often. Soothing Images and Diversion are effective counters.
* A Spirit of Truth will spawn near to the reward Chest after his death.
* To get the Torc'qua Chest, all Margonites must be killed. You may find that a couple hide beyond the hill towards The Stygian Veil. Approaching this area will cause them to come toward you.

records/boss:3:bb6a3e1f7d402098/npc/note.text: *A large number of Stygian demons and Torment Claws are spawned following the death of each Smothering Tendril, potentially overwhelming an over-enthusiastic party.

records/boss:3:567bb60c38d96d77/npc/note.text:
*There is a miniature version of this NPC.
*One of the Mysterious Tonic's forms.
*One of the Mysterious Summoning Stone's summons.
*Despite being a dervish, its unique drop is a shield.

records/boss:3:fc1e77ef64943aae/npc/note.text: * He spawns with Hauseh the Defiler, Tanmahk the Arcane, and several Graven Monoliths when the first Abaddon Shrine on the right is destroyed.

records/boss:3:c32e328bc8568cff/npc/note.text:
* Even though his type is Mummy, holy damage does not do double damage to him.
* He wields a hammer.

records/boss:3:1200c28099450089/npc/note.text:
* Even though his type is Mummy, holy damage does not do double damage to him.
* He wields a hammer.

records/boss:3:1f0d1fcf5ec2ee9a/npc/note.text:
* Even though his type is Mummy, holy damage does not do double damage to him.
* He wields a hammer.

records/boss:3:33173bee2ba7711c/npc/note.text:
* Pikin was accidently removed after the "International Talk like a Pirate Day" event. He was put back in a later update
* Shares the skill Shatter Enchantment with Libeh and the skill Empowerment with Shiloh, making him one of only a few hero skill trainers that teaches the same skill as another hero skill trainer. The only other two hero skill trainers with this trait are the aforementioned Libeh and Shiloh.

records/boss:4:ad91b09af76d2779/npc/note.text: * Johon the Oxflinger was named by Jonathan Aiken through the 2007 Brand The Boss contest.

records/boss:4:0709d32e56924368/npc/note.text: * This boss has a large patrol path in the northwestern section of the area. His group travels either in a clockwise or counter-clockwise manner, which can make encountering them difficult.

records/boss:4:4d5216a92d9f9e91/npc/note.text:
* While he uses predominantly warrior skills (including his elite), he has a paragon aura and will drop paragon tomes.
* The cave where this boss is located serves to farm Archaic Maul in regular quantities, it's one of the common items that the Kveldulf can drop.

records/boss:4:8f3576f20a1dcab8/npc/note.text: * You do not have to kill him to complete the quest In the Service of Revenge.

records/boss:4:857c56565f03a8ea/npc/note.text: * Unlike many bosses in Eye of the North, he does not possess Natural Resistance.

records/boss:4:1ea5162f911bbe34/npc/note.text:
* Jormungand spawns alongside two Frost Wurms.
* If the boss does not appear, a solitary Frozen Elemental or Frost Wurm will sometimes spawn instead.
** Some players believe that the appearance of these other foes at any potential spawning location means that Jormungand will not appear in the current instance. However, no one has published sufficient research to confirm or deny this theory.

records/boss:4:82a8fe0418eaf508/npc/note.text:
*Often he is found in one of the patrol groups that go either clockwise or counterclockwise around the lake instead of staying in one place.
*Sometimes, Koren and his group will be killed by other monsters in the area, making it seem as if they never spawned. This will not update the quest.

records/boss:4:9e7e9d861db40630/npc/note.text:
* Approaching or flagging a hero to Nulfastu's tree will lead to spawning all enemies, some of which will remain level 5 rabbits.
* On the Notorious Foe signpost and in all linked quests his name has a comma: Nulfastu, Earthbound. However, the name of the NPC himself does not contain a comma.

records/boss:4:16146d8ec7d7bea2/npc/note.text:
* She doesn't use her own scythe, but an Asuran Scythe.
* Myish, Lady Of The Lake is at the center of Drakkar Lake, surrounded by groups of Frozen Elementals and Chilling Wisps with wide patrol paths. Consider dispatching the patrols with careful pulling before confronting the boss.
* The frozen lake around Myish causes Icy Ground, however she may be lured to a little island to the southwest, therefore negating the environmental effect.

records/boss:4:65ffdfc5ee45426a/npc/note.text: * He will spawn from the start, but not become hostile until all other points in the quest have been cleared.

records/boss:4:d0c12b704c0b7e54/npc/note.text: * In normal mode, it takes him 8-10 minutes to patrol his route. In hard mode, he will run his route in 2 minutes.

records/boss:4:2dfa02aa4c9a8f9d/npc/note.text:
* Jormungand spawns alongside two Frost Wurms.
* If the boss does not appear, a solitary Frozen Elemental or Frost Wurm will sometimes spawn instead.
** Some players believe that the appearance of these other foes at any potential spawning location means that Jormungand will not appear in the current instance. However, no one has published sufficient research to confirm or deny this theory.

records/boss:4:f937cf5d1b8d2776/npc/note.text:
* Upon coming within range of the Stone Summit Gnashers, they will begin a dialogue to "summon" Lord Glacius.
** If you attack the group before the summoning is complete, they may end their dialogue early. The summoning process will still complete when the dialogue would have finished as long as one of the Gnashers is alive. If you kill all of the Gnashers before they complete the summoning, Lord Glacius the Eternal will not appear.

records/boss:4:e7e3494d9ba36bc7/npc/note.text: * In the German language version they are called "Lissah der Rudelführer" which would indicate they are male (otherwise it would be "Lissah die Rudelführerin").

records/boss:4:931e64e70b9935df/npc/note.text:
*He is a warrior in Jaga Moraine and uses the Stone Summit Herder model.
*He is a monk in Sorrow's Furnace and uses a Stone Summit Taskmaster model
**He is an ally due to Chains of Enslavement.

records/boss:4:5311e586df981c40/npc/note.text:
* He is one of the bosses to be killed for the quest Anything You Can Do. When you approach him a number of Bone Fiends will appear. These Bone Fiends are not minions, thus he can't use Taste of Death on them and his Dark Bond won't work either. Also, Verata's Aura and Verata's Gaze cannot gain control of these creatures. 
* Although he is a Norn, he does not use Bear Form because he fell from the grace of the Bear Spirit.
* Despite this being an 8 person area, it is possible to take the route shown, defeating very few mobs along the way, to reach and defeat this boss with a 4 person team. That can help improve the odds of receiving the unique weapon drop.

records/boss:4:095c9568020d08fd/npc/note.text:
* It does huge amounts of AoE damage and often causes knockdown.
* Replaced by Edielh Shockhunter after completion of Prenuptial Disagreement.
* Pain Inverter will be useful, as it will trigger more often due to the AoE, and additionally up to three times per ally because of Shockwave.
* This boss, like most Wurm bosses, does not need to be killed when vanquishing as long as it is not above ground.
* If this boss dies while underground, you will not be able to capture skills from it.

records/boss:4:458e21dd2c15bd4e/npc/note.text:
* Whiteout resides at the top of a steep rise, on a narrow path. 
** Beware of tumbling boulders that can instantly kill anyone in their path. 
** If you are using heroes and/or henchmen, flag them at the bottom of the rise, the walk up the path to trigger the boulders so that you can more easily dodge them.
* Whiteout is accompanied by an Avalanche and two Ice Elementals, but is very vulnerable to fire damage.
** Focus everyone's attack on Whiteout and he will go down quickly. After killing him your party will be able to take out the rest of the enemies.
** To farm this boss, rezone at the nearby Frostmaw's Burrows dungeon portal.

records/boss:4:e2ff365e01c693a5/npc/note.text: *Try to take out the patrols nearby before you attempt to kill him or you might find yourself overwhelmed.

records/boss:4:23ca569f745d05e6/npc/note.text:
* When close to the edge of the player's compass, Molotov Rocktail will begin a patrol to the north east and continue a short way into the forest.
* His Devourer Siege can easily wipe out a party that is not spread out; flag heroes and henchmen around or underneath him and either interrupt or blind him, preventing both his Devourer Siege and Power Attack.
* You can tank Rocktail using the nearby Siege Devourer: since it rarely uses Devourer Siege once in melee, you can use the durability of the Siege Devourer to approach it alone and lock it in melee safely, even in hard mode.
* Molotov Rocktail has an extended aggro range, much like Kournan Spotters.
* Due to Devourer Siege, Pain Inverter is very effective, since it reflects damage from your minions, spirits, summons, and animal companions.

records/boss:4:07bad902f0752ff8/npc/note.text: * The Flaming Scepter Mages replace Hodat and the accompanying group of Stone Furies before completion of Forgotten Relics.

records/boss:4:7f58016728744cd5/npc/note.text: *Groknar Weazlewortz was named by You Will Know Fear through the 2007 Brand The Boss contest.

records/boss:4:14540d106bccc048/npc/note.text: *It is possible that Gordam Griefgiver is from the same Warband as Blazefiend Griefblade.

records/boss:4:164c15ace90f4d85/npc/note.text:
* Care must be taken with this group (and the other groups of Burning Spirits), as they have a wide patrol range and can quickly ambush and wipe your group while fighting other enemies. They are also highly resistant to fire damage and immune to burning, so other categories of elemental spells should be used against them. 
* Consider bringing AoE interrupts such as Cry of Frustration, Tease, or a ranger with Choking Gas. 
:* The interrupt Complicate, when used on Searing Flames, is particularly effective as it will shut down the entire mob's main source of damage.
* Hex Eater Vortex and Shatter Hex can also be useful in removing Mark of Rodgort from melee characters and dealing large armor-ignoring damage to nearby foes. 
* Pre-interrupts such as Guilt and Mistrust can help in interrupting the multiple copies of Searing Flames.
* Winter will prevent Mark of Rodgort and the spike damage from Searing Flames from triggering and significantly boost damage from your elemental sources.
* Elementalists should consider bringing Frigid Armor to effectively prevent any damage from Searing Flames.

records/boss:4:7eb06b8036c18f54/npc/note.text:
*You need to have done the Assault on the Stronghold mission before you will be able to reach him.
*He will not spawn if you have the quest Forbidden Fruit active.

records/boss:4:723d92a611d37586/npc/note.text:
* As a hammer warrior, he can be handled with any anti-melee build.
* As with Borrguus Blisterbark, it is a good idea to kill the roving patrols of Burning Spirits before you take him and his group on, otherwise it is very likely that you will get ambushed and likely wiped out.
* Ignus is the only Titan boss who does not follow the typical naming convention of Titan bosses of two pseudo-Latin words.

records/boss:4:1302217bd86d741e/npc/note.text:
* The fight is made difficult by the large number of both Grawl Champions and Grawl Dark Priests which surround him. Approaching him from the south, four of the closest Grawl Champions can be pulled away from the group, but all the others attack cohesively along with the boss.
* Area-of-effect anti-melee hexes such as Meekness and Enfeebling Blood are very useful, along with wards such as Ward Against Melee and Ebon Battle Standard of Courage. As always, a minion master can greatly help redirect damage from the team.

records/boss:4:e08cf5197aedb967/npc/note.text: * A Charr Effigy will spawn once he is aggroed.

records/boss:4:fcc20e749a612a20/npc/note.text: * As with various quest-related foes, once it spawns, it might cause an additional Locked Chest to spawn.

records/boss:4:a8371f2754b82690/npc/note.text:
* His route is approximately 5 minutes in length, varying in direction and path per spawn. It patrols around the edge of the northeastern lagoon more often than the south route.
* Flannuss usually becomes stuck on a cliff almost directly south of Vlox's Falls, at the northernmost tip of the land jutting into the river delta - marked with the monk icon on the wiki map. The quickest way to locate the boss should be to travel clockwise on the red path. Alternatively, wait in the spot where it may get stuck - both patrol routes overlap here.
* An easy (but repetitive) method for killing Flannuss is to zone into Arbor Bay from Vlox's Falls head forward, killing the first two groups of Krait and heading left along the cliff tops. If he is not there, he will likely be there in two minutes - otherwise he is on the other route, so rezone and try again.

records/boss:4:ff8222791052a72b/npc/note.text: * Dragon Slash is his only adrenal skill, limiting its usefulness.

records/boss:4:b69d80e6808beebf/npc/note.text: * She has an Elder Black Widow as a pet. You cannot charm this Black Widow.

records/boss:4:8c5bdefb24d76b1b/npc/note.text:
* Gallow Nooseknitter was named by Will Bonner (Hustler Warrior) through the 2007 Brand The Boss contest.
* If you're farming this boss, you can use the portal just southeast of it to rezone and come back.

records/boss:4:7086a2700915a67d/npc/note.text:
*The Facet of Existence has a random spawn location in Riven Earth. Known spawn locations:
*#Northwest of the Golem Foundry.
*#Directly east from Rata Sum, before the second resurrection shrine.
*#Up the hill slightly southwest of the center resurrection shrine.
*#Northeast of center, northeast of the short bridge north of center, between the northern and northeastern resurrection shrines (see map).
*#Southeast corner, in the raised area overlooking the waterfall from the north.
*As the first spawn point is so close to Rata Sum, it may be worth reloading the map until you get this spawn. It can be reached without combat.

records/boss:4:e3d76e011437c43b/npc/note.text:
* He can hit hard, so it is advised to take some interrupt skills.
* Spoil Victor and Pain Inverter are very effective against Joffs. Enchantment removal will also help by removing his protective spells.
* Due to the nature of the damage from Shockwave, it is advisable to space out your party as best as you possibly can to avoid a devastating spike which could very well kill your entire party.
* After killing the surrounding enemies, it is possible to lure Joffs to the southeast past a large rock/hill, where he will become stuck as he tries to get back to his spawn. It is then possible to defeat him with minimal casualties as he will simply walk back and forth as you attack him.

records/boss:4:1f3ce10cee0f0a4b/npc/note.text:
* The Broodmother's cave is just south of the northern exit in Rata Sum. Not far from her spawn point, you can find a Jar of Invigoration; when dropped, it provides 30 energy to all nearby creatures.
* The cave is filled with three large groups of level 15 Raptor Nestlings. Although they deal relatively little damage, they spam Disrupting Stab, preventing your team from using skills effectively. Rekoff herself deals large amounts of damage. Bring a team that can deal effectively with significant amounts of melee and bring interruption counter-tactics.
* Since the cave is so close to Rata Sum, her group is used to farm Asura reputation points and festival trophy drops. The popularity of the farm also means that Claws of the Broodmother are very common and do not trade at a premium.

records/boss:4:06e222e1ef34653d/npc/note.text:
* You can counter Mobrin's heavy damage with skills that cause weakness or blindness.
* Compared to a regular Tyrannus, Mobrin trades out the anti-block knockdown of Leviathan's Sweep for the cleaving potential of Sweeping Strikes.

records/boss:4:31e68f11c60a9635/npc/note.text:
* They have the usual golden warrior boss aura, with an additional purple circular inscription aura about the height of their chest.
* Despite being Ettins, they drop Jotun items.
* They appear to be functionally identical to Inscribed Sentries.

records/boss:4:5e81e60b0cb17ca2/npc/note.text:
* The Facet of Death has a random spawn location in Sparkfly Swamp. Known spawn locations:
*# Eastern edge of the central clearing, up the hill to the south of the easternmost edge of the swamp. 
*# Southeast of center, at the three way crossroads north of the resurrection shrine.
*# In the center of the Agari territory.
*# Northeast of center, at the three way crossroads between the resurrection shrine at the eastern edge of the swamp and Brynn Earthporter's alcove.

records/boss:4:e01c513bbe1c8e21/npc/note.text:
* A Siege Devourer can be used to easily take down the large mob that accompanies Fureyst Sharpsight, making the battle considerably easier. 
** It is possible to acquire one early directly to the south of Doomlore Shrine in Dalada Uplands. Take then the portal to Grothmar Wardowns then go south to Sacnoth Valley for a slightly faster route.
** In Hard Mode, a Siege Devourer will spawn near Fureyst Sharpsight. With a runner it is possible to quickly reach Rragar's Menagerie, zone there, then reenter Sacnoth Valley, take the devourer and proceed from there. The runner can still be useful in combat by mounting the devourer themselves.

records/boss:4:afda21b9ac0f6c65/npc/note.text:
* A Siege Devourer can be used to easily take down the large mob that accompanies Fureyst Sharpsight, making the battle considerably easier. 
** It is possible to acquire one early directly to the south of Doomlore Shrine in Dalada Uplands. Take then the portal to Grothmar Wardowns then go south to Sacnoth Valley for a slightly faster route.
** In Hard Mode, a Siege Devourer will spawn near Fureyst Sharpsight. With a runner it is possible to quickly reach Rragar's Menagerie, zone there, then reenter Sacnoth Valley, take the devourer and proceed from there. The runner can still be useful in combat by mounting the devourer themselves.
